tasks.label: azurite: start
tasks.detail: Starts the Blob emulator the API needs, reusing the container after the first run.
tasks.command: docker start andes-mailer-azurite 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name andes-mailer-azurite -p 10000:10000 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-storage/azurite azurite-blob --blobHost 0.0.0.0 --skipApiVersionCheck

windows.command: docker start andes-mailer-azurite 2>nul || docker run -d --name andes-mailer-azurite -p 10000:10000 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-storage/azurite azurite-blob --blobHost 0.0.0.0 --skipApiVersionCheck
